name: Fractal Flame
desc: An electric-sheep fractal flame born from a chaos game of affine maps folded through sinusoidal, swirl, horseshoe and handkerchief variations, accumulated into a log-density histogram and gamma tone-mapped into luminous drifting tendrils over a breathing indigo ground — switchable to thermal heat-map, sumi ink on paper, oil-slick iridescence, or silver burin engraving.

energy.doc: exposure / bloom brightness + iteration count (first numeric — blazing at max)

density.doc: chaos iterations per frame 1110->3000 (sparse sparkle -> dense)

warp.doc: affine<->nonlinear-variation blend (0 = crisp linear IFS, 1 = full flame swirl)

gamma.doc: tone-map gamma (low = hard core, high = faint tendrils lifted)

system.doc: IFS family — flame is nonlinear; fern/sierpinski/dragon are classic linear IFS

seed.doc: deterministic variation (flame affines + variation assignment + palette phase)
